core_problem_solved: To provide a test runner that integrates the Arquillian container-based testing model with the TestNG testing framework, allowing developers to execute true integration tests inside a running container.
key_features: A TestNG test listener for the Arquillian framework
Manages the lifecycle of test deployments to a target container
Enables injection of real application components directly into test classes
era_and_niche: A core component of the Arquillian testing ecosystem, essential for any project wishing to perform in-container integration testing for Jakarta EE or Spring applications using TestNG.
reason_for_obsolescence: The library is **not obsolete**. Its primary competitor for a wide range of integration test cases is now the **Testcontainers** pattern. Within its own ecosystem, it is the direct alternative to **`org.jboss.arquillian.junit:arquillian-junit-container`**.
